name: xuan-ji-yu-heng
description: Deterministically calculate Western natal charts, Four Pillars/BaZi, Zi Wei Dou Shu, and bounded Vedic/Jyotish charts. Vedic output defaults to the mean-node convention while still reporting both node modes; its high-precision statement is limited to the documented Swiss-only external numeric-reference fixture. All math is done by a bundled offline CLI; the model never computes charts.
